slides.title: Ethiopia raises accusations with the UN envoy
Protect civilians. Peaceful dialogue.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

card.title: “Talking, not shooting is the best game in town.”
card.body: Getachew Reda, PM Abiy's Horn of Africa adviser, after meeting UN envoy Guang Cong. He accused Eritrea's and Sudan's leaders of arming groups in Ethiopia; not independently verified.
